# NEET-UG 2026 leak: why the protests began (research, 2026-11-13)

Machine-readable facts and verbatim snippets: `data/story/neet.json` (fact ids neet01 to neet21, new source ids all prefixed `neet_`). Status is draft.

## 1. The exam
- Held 3 May 2026 by the NTA across 551 Indian cities and 14 abroad, "more than 5,400 centres" (DT Next/ANI copy; neet03, partial). Careers360/PTI: "nearly 23 lakh registered candidates".
- 22.79 lakh registered (NTA, via IANS in The News Minute; neet02). "Around 22 lakh appeared" (TNM, Scroll). Use "registered" for 22.79 lakh.
- NTA primary notice (nta.ac.in) not fetched; every NTA quote comes via press copy.

## 2. The leak (alleged, not established in court)
- NTA said it got inputs about alleged malpractice on the evening of 7 May and escalated them to central agencies on 8 May (PTI; neet04).
- Rajasthan SOG ADG Vishal Bansal (to The Economic Times, via Scroll): a "guess paper" of about 410 questions, about 120 matching the chemistry section (neet06). Quint, citing Deccan Herald, says it circulated on WhatsApp and Telegram. Quint is flagged AI-assisted and secondhand; treat the platforms as "reported".
- More than 45 detained in Rajasthan (India Today via Scroll); a Nashik man taken into custody (The Hindu via Scroll) (neet07). Detained, not arrested.
- Origin: Rajasthan DGP Anand Kumar Shrivastava said it was traced to a Kerala medical student; TNM also says a printing-press origin was suspected. Preliminary and conflicting; state no origin (neet08).
- CBI chargesheet 28 Jul: 13 arrested accused, alleging a conspiracy involving NTA subject experts, middlemen and coaching-institute associates; 360 witnesses (ThePrint/PTI, Business Today; neet13). Allegations until trial.

## 3. The response
- 12 May: NTA cancelled the exam, "with the approval of the Government of India"; Union government referred the case to the CBI; CBI registered an FIR the same day (PTI; neet05, neet09). Fees refunded, no fresh registration.
- First full cancellation: Quint citing Indian Express only (secondhand, AI-assisted). Do not use without a better source.
- 15 May: re-exam announced for 21 Jun (NTA on X; neet10). 21 Jun: "more than 20 lakh candidates appeared ... across 5,440 centres in India and 14 centres abroad" (NTA statement via Siasat; neet11).
- Refunds "more than Rs 300 crore" (ETV Bharat, carried over from existing data; neet12).
- Minister statements: Pradhan's 25 Jul letter says he took responsibility "from day one" (neet20). No 12 May ministerial quote fetched.

## 4. The link to the CJP
- It was not founded over NEET. CJP was announced 16 May as satire after the CJI remark (Al Jazeera; neet15).
- First NEET-linked CJP action found: 22 May campaign demanding Pradhan's resignation, "centres on ... the NEET-UG 2026 'paper-leak' controversy" (PTI; neet16). Dipke: "It was the fault of the system that over 22 lakh students' future was impacted, it was the fault of the system that NEET students committed suicide."
- 6 Jun Jantar Mantar: "We asked for 'Make in India', you gave us 'Leak in India'" (ANI via FPJ; neet17).
- 11 Jun Pune: five-point "exam manifesto", Rs 10,000 per candidate when an exam is cancelled, leaked or disrupted (neet18).
- 20 Jul memo to Nadda: Pradhan's resignation (core demand "from Day 1"), Rs 1 crore per family of NEET aspirants who died by suicide, Wangchuk's release; "21 students (as per our records)" is CJP's own claim (neet19).
- 25 Jul: Pradhan resigned; CJP marked two demands "PENDING" (neet20).

## 5. CJI remark (15 May)
Made in a Supreme Court hearing on Senior Advocate designation, not a NEET matter (The Wire, FPJ; neet14). The CJI said on 16 May he meant holders of fake law degrees. No source ties the remark to NEET. The link is Dipke's: "If you had not called us 'cockroaches', I would not have returned to India" (neet21).

## Proposed 3-caption storyline (each at most 40 words)
1. "NEET-UG was held on 3 May; the NTA reported 22.79 lakh registered candidates. Police said a 'guess paper' of about 410 questions, about 120 matching the chemistry section, circulated beforehand. The CBI later alleged a conspiracy; trial is pending." (38 words)
2. "On 12 May the NTA cancelled the exam with government approval, and the CBI registered an FIR. The re-test was set for 21 June; the NTA said more than 20 lakh candidates sat it." (35 words)
3. "The CJP began as satire on 16 May. On 22 May, PTI reported, it started a campaign over the NEET leak, demanding Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation. He resigned on 25 July." (31 words)

Each carries `*` footers: NTA/PTI (claimant), CBI, "CJP claims". Caption 1 "police said" is Rajasthan SOG via Scroll.

## Conflicts
- Founding vs demand: CJP's 16 May launch was about the CJI remark; Dipke later said "Our only demand since the inception of this movement has been the resignation of Dharmendra Pradhan" (Dynamite News, 12 Jun). Dated coverage shows the NEET demand from 22 May.
- 35 days: PTI counts from 20 Jun sit-in; resignation demand was public from 22 May and 6 Jun.
- Suicides: CJP says 21; an open letter reported 11 in a week (Medical Dialogues, search only). Unverified either way.
- Leak origin: Kerala student vs printing press. Counts: "22 lakh+", "22.79 lakh", "nearly 23 lakh".
- Outlook says the NTA cancelled exams "held on May 3 and May 7"; no other source says this, so ignored.
